voices.text: A story spoken is a story shared, and the listener fills in the rest.

music_sections.character: dark, tense, expensive: sub pulse and a filtered heartbeat kick under a rising noise and pad swell, 16th ticks creeping in; one hard stab-plus-impact on the click at 2.0, then a short tail that is gone by 3.15 (the room goes silent before the voice)

the drop at 6.0 is the big moment: impact plus the full groove (punchy kick, clap on 2 and 4, crisp hats, sidechained supersaw chords, gliding sub). The three title words land on 6.0, 8.0 and 10.0, each with a stab accent. From 12.0 a filtered-down build (hats, rising noise, snare roll optional) into one hit on the Speak click at 14.0, then a fast release to silence by 14.55

second drop at 18.5 as the logo arrives (impact plus full groove, brightest statement of the chords); the final hit at 20.5 on the next bar, then everything but a pad and a reverb tail drops away and fades to digital silence by 22.5. This section's bar grid starts at 18.5
